title: rosa granulosa var. coreana
intro: Rosa granulosa var. coreana, commonly known as Korean rose or Korean rose hips, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The health benefits of Rosa granulosa var. coreana include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of promoting wound healing, reducing oxidative stress, and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
